mapper.select: SELECT * FROM my_manage WHERE MANAGE_NAME = #{manageName} AND IS_ENABLE = 120001
SELECT MANAGE_LEVEL FROM my_manage WHERE MANAGE_NAME = #{manageName}
SELECT b.COMMUNITY_NAME FROM `my_manage` a JOIN `my_community` b WHERE a.COMMUNITY_CODE = b.COMMUNITY_CODE AND a.MANAGE_NAME = #{manageName}
SELECT b.AREA_NAME FROM `my_manage` a JOIN `my_community_area` b WHERE a.AREA_CODE = b.AREA_CODE AND a.MANAGE_NAME = #{manageName}

-- GROUP_CONCAT(a,b)函数，a是查询的字段，b是拼接方式，将多条字段拼接为一组数据 -- FIND_IN_SET(str,strlist)，该函数的作用是查询字段(strlist) 中是否包含(str)的结果 SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(b.BUILD_NAME) BUILD_NAME_LIST FROM `my_manage` a JOIN `my_community_build` b ON FIND_IN_SET(b.BUILD_CODE,a.BUILD_CODE) WHERE a.MANAGE_NAME = #{manageName}

SELECT a.ID, a.MANAGE_CODE, a.MANAGE_NAME, a.PHONE, a.MANAGE_LEVEL, a.IS_ENABLE, (CASE WHEN a.AREA_CODE IS NULL THEN 'X' ELSE b.AREA_NAME END) AREA_CODE, -- a.BUILD_CODE (CASE WHEN a.BUILD_CODE IS NULL THEN 'X' ELSE a.BUILD_CODE -- ELSE GROUP_CONCAT(c.BUILD_NAME) END) BUILD_CODE FROM `my_manage` a -- JOIN `my_community_build` c ON FIND_IN_SET(c.BUILD_CODE,a.BUILD_CODE) LEFT JOIN `my_community_area` b ON a.AREA_CODE = b.AREA_CODE WHERE a.COMMUNITY_CODE = '${po.communityCode}'
AND a.ID LIKE '%${po.Id}%'
AND a.MANAGE_CODE LIKE '%${po.manageCode}%'
AND a.MANAGE_NAME LIKE '%${po.manageName}%'
AND a.MANAGE_LEVEL LIKE '%${po.manageLevel}%'
AND a.IS_ENABLE LIKE '%${po.isEnable}%'
